verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a tax-calculation service, since tax engines can be deployed on-premises, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a Stripe-hosted API and Dashboard; the sandbox is a hosted test environment, and calculating tax on payments processed outside Stripe still runs on Stripe's hosted service. No self-hostable deployment is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
